text:
Priya: :warning: Asia-SE GPU pool reporting sustained 95% used and ~15% eviction rate, affecting low-prio dedicated jobs. Logs show preemption storms after 08:02 UTC.
Daniel: pulling metrics now. can you paste the autoscaler status?
Priya: `kubectl get hpa -n infra gpu-autoscaler -o yaml` -> showing maxReplicas: 200 but desired: 30, nodes at capacity 92%. suspect quota at cloud provider side.
Li: I see a cloud-side allocation error in the events: "Exceeded regional GPU quota: request not fulfilled". Support ticket opened with provider (TKT-9876).
Marco: If quota is blocked we should traffic-shift realtime inference traffic to eu-west2 and us-central temporarily. Can we flip the smart-routing policy to prefer fallback region?
Priya: yes, we can use the routing switch: `redwoodctl route set --policy soft-fanout --primary eu-west2 --fallback asia-se` — but soft-fanout keeps some traffic local which will still overload capacity. I suggest full divert for 30m.
Daniel: agree. I'll trigger divert and lower batch size on replicas to reduce KV cache pressure: set BATCH_TOKEN_LIMIT=128 across inference pods.
Elena: heads-up: diverting will increase p95 by ~120ms for some customers. We should annotate the incident for product/CS so they can triage impacted customers.
incidentbot: Incident created: INC-20260315-asia-gpu-quota. Paging policy applied: high-severity pages to oncall within 2m. Current pages: 1 (Priya).
Priya: updating runbook — changing autoscaler burst window to 120s and enabling emergency-provisioning rule that accepts spot->on-demand uplift for 10 nodes.
Li: provider support confirmed partial quota increase but estimate ~45m for fulfillment. We need to keep failover active until then.
Marco: manual traffic-shift initiated at 08:17 UTC. Command: `redwoodctl traffic shift --from asia-se --to eu-west2 --percent 100 --comment "quota overflow"`.
Daniel: reducing low-prio job concurrency with `kubejobctl scale --label=low-prio --replicas=1` to reclaim ~8 GPUs.
Elena: tagging incident with customers impacted: socialfeed, docsearch. Notifying CS.
Priya: setting pagerflow tweak proposal: if quota-exceeding errors persist for >10m, route to oncall-escalation channel and auto-divert traffic. Drafting PR in infra/playbooks.
Marco: noted. Oncall handoff at 09:00 UTC: Priya -> Daniel. Priya will remain watching for provider update.
Priya: thanks all — keeping this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
